headline: UK Parliamentary Report Warns of Dangerous Reliance on China for Critical Minerals
summary: A UK parliamentary business select committee report warned that Britain is dangerously reliant on China for raw materials vital to defense, renewable energy, and artificial intelligence infrastructure.
why: Critical raw materials are key inputs for semiconductor fabrication, energy transition hardware, and advanced manufacturing.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Critical mineral reliance poses supply vulnerability risks for UK industrial, AI, and defense sectors.
